Hi Sam,

Quick intro - I’m Camila on the SDR team at Redwood Inference. I noticed your team recently signed up for self-serve and crossed a usage threshold that typically indicates folks are ready for a short guided session. Congrats on the traction!

If helpful, we’d love to schedule a 30-minute prompted demo tailored to your current flow (embeddings + context routing) and to walk through cost/latency tradeoffs for your workload. Agenda would be:
- Quick intros and goals (5m)
- How Acme’s current usage patterns map to model/quantization recommendations (10m)
- Live demo & Q&A + next steps (15m)

Available slots this week:
- Thu 2/26 10:00-10:30 PT
- Thu 2/26 14:00-14:30 PT
- Mon 3/1 11:00-11:30 PT

I’ve attached a short intro deck and a screenshot showing the usage pattern we saw from your account for context. Jordan (AE) and Marissa (Sales Eng) are cc’d and can join to cover pricing and technical fit.

If none of these work, tell me a couple of times that do and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Best,

--
Camila Reyes

camila@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182
